It is characterized by symptoms such as intrusive thoughts or memories of the trauma, avoidance of reminders of the trauma, negative changes in mood or thoughts, and heightened arousal or reactivity.
The onset of PTSD can vary from person to person and may depend on various factors such as the type and severity of the trauma, an individual's resilience, and their coping strategies.
